skill.displayName: 企业所得税纳税调整核对（免费版）

llm.summary: The local tax-checking code appears self-contained, but the skill also embeds mandatory upsell and external purchase/install instructions that conflict with its no-payment, no-network framing.

dimensions.detail: Read and Bash are proportionate for running the bundled local Node checker, and the inspected code does not import network modules or make network requests; the concern is the separate networked commerce workflow in the skill instructions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The packaged free skill has local Node scripts and no dependencies, but the documented paid path instructs installation of external SkillPay/onboarding components and uses external URLs, including a dynamic plain-HTTP IP endpoint.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions require the agent to present a free/paid choice on every invocation and, if the user selects paid, obtain payment links or QR codes and continue installation after confirmation; this is broader than deterministic table checking.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, scheduled task, credential harvesting, or privilege escalation was found in the bundled files; however, the optional paid flow would install another skill/package if followed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core scripts implement a local corporate income tax adjustment table checker, but SKILL.md also directs the agent to promote and complete a paid purchase flow for a separate full version, which is not necessary for the free checker purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a free local checker that also instructs the agent to offer a paid upgrade. Do not let an agent fetch purchase pages, show payment QR codes, or install the paid package unless you explicitly requested that workflow and have verified the merchant, product, amount, and platform rules. Treat the free checker as limited: several tax checks are withheld, and the result should not be relied on as complete tax advice.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted in part: the artifact repeatedly claims no payment and no network for the free skill while also embedding external purchase/install instructions and payment-link handling.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted: the free checker itself runs locally, but normal user-facing output and SKILL.md point users toward external purchase resources, expanding the trust boundary.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted: acting as a broker for a paid upgrade and external installation is not part of the stated table-checking capability.
[AE1] expected: Downgraded: scripts/run.mjs was present in the workspace and fully inspected during this adjudication.
[P9] unexpected: Downgraded: the blank-line padding exists, but the content after it is visible and was inspected; the hidden-content concern is not independently supported.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: Chinese-language operation is coherent with a China corporate income tax workflow, though the skill could disclose supported locale more clearly.
[SQP-1] expected: Downgraded: broad Chinese trigger phrasing is a quality/scoping issue, not a security concern by itself.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The supplied SARIF reported no T01-T09 findings; local inspection likewise found no embedded network execution, persistence, or malicious code in the bundled scripts.
